sources.claim: STACKx Cybersecurity 2026 held April 17 at MBS Sands Expo; three tracks on AI cyber-defence, securing AI, and cyber leadership; S$80–150 registration
Black Hat Asia 2026 held April 21–24 at Marina Bay Sands; 3,500+ attendees, 110+ speakers, 200+ exhibitors
AWS Summit Singapore 2026 held May 6; free; 45+ sessions on cloud and agentic AI; recordings on-demand
ATxEnterprise 2026 ran May 20–22 at Singapore EXPO; 22,000+ total ATxSG attendees
ATxSummit 2026 held May 20–21 at Capella Singapore; invitation-only; IMDA-led
AI Summit Singapore 2026 ran May 20–22 as part of ATxEnterprise; 2,000+ attendees
SuperAI 2026 runs June 10–11 at Marina Bay Sands; 10,000+ attendees, 150+ speakers; $499 USD early-bird; NEXT Hackathon $130k+ prizes; Genesis Competition $850k prizes
PyCon Singapore 2026 runs June 19–21 at Lifelong Learning Institute; keynotes from Google, NUS, Python Software Foundation, Hugging Face
Tech Week Singapore 2026 runs September 29–30 at Marina Bay Sands; five co-located events
TOKEN2049 Singapore 2026 runs October 7–8; 25,000+ attendees from 7,000+ companies; 300+ speakers including Vitalik Buterin
SWITCH 2026 runs October 27–29; free attendee passes; 400+ exhibitors; SLINGSHOT S$2M+ grant prizes; application deadline June 30, 2026
Singapore FinTech Festival 2026 runs November 18–20; 70,000+ participants from 142 countries; 600+ exhibitors; early-bird SGD 750 before Jul 31
STACK Conference 2026 is GovTech Singapore's largest government-led tech event; date TBD H2 2026
CIO Leaders Summit Singapore 2026 held June 1 at Marina Bay Sands; ~150 senior IT executives; 12 speakers
